rationale: RENDERS CARRY THE IMPORTED-BINDING CLAIM — for an EXTERNAL package component. The TS claim pass stakes binding claims only on specifiers that are not project-local (the lane's ruling: a project-local name can be resolved by the name model, and a claim would displace a possibly-correct binding), and a JSX tag from `element-plus` is exactly the external case, so `renders App -> ElButton` must carry metadata.importedBinding {specifier: element-plus, binding: ElButton} — the store verifies it against the file's own imports evidence. The second tag, `Local` from the relative specifier `./local`, is the CONTROL: it must carry NO claim, and the forbid pins that the ruling is a decision and not an accident (a change that starts claiming project-local bindings will fail here before it steals resolvable edges). The tag shapes are pinned by tsx-renders; this fixture is about the claim channel only.
